reasons: The lake identity record matches the asserted title, U.S. Supreme Court court, 1970 decision year, docket 108, and date decided 1970-02-25.
The lake citation record includes the official citation 397 U.S. 72, parallel citations 90 S. Ct. 774 and 25 L. Ed. 2d 60, and vendor-neutral citation 1970 U.S. LEXIS 66.
No disclosed treatment edge says the authority has been overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited, but the treatment record is explicitly unverified.
residual_risks: Live-law status is not affirmatively established because the lake treatment fields are unverified and progeny edges are empty.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep identity/existence separate from any good-law claim; do not infer current validity from the citation alone.

defect.evidence_quote: Frontier stub: treatment/progeny intentionally not derived until S6 promotion.
defect.problem: The home role labels the case as 'Key — Foundational,' but the disclosed treatment/progeny record does not verify that current doctrinal status.
defect.proposed_fix: Downgrade the role to an unverified/admin-search role or qualify it as authored orientation until treatment/progeny derivation supports the 'Key — Foundational' label.

reasons: Lens B treats the 'Key — Foundational' role as a current weight/status label.

The lake progeny section has rows_cached 0 and no outbound opinion edges, so the disclosed record does not substantiate foundational current status.
residual_risks: The label may be correct after full treatment/progeny review, but that evidence is not disclosed here.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use 'Administrative-search case — treatment unverified' unless the corpus has a verified treatment/progeny basis for 'Key — Foundational.'

reasons: The lake identity record identifies the court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level as scotus.

residual_risks: Readers could confuse hierarchy weight with verified current validity.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Clarify that 'Binding — SCOTUS' is a court-hierarchy label, not a verified good-law treatment label.

defect.problem: The structured treatment payload correctly says treatment is unverified, but the content page's treatment prose also says 'Good law — foundational,' which exceeds the disclosed lake treatment record.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep the structured treatment as unverified and change the prose heading from 'Good law — foundational' to 'Treatment unverified — authored orientation' or remove the good-law label until S6 promotion verifies treatment/progeny.

reasons: The lake treatment fields match the inventory payload: field_i_validity unverified, as_of_content null, as_of_treatment null, composite_basis unverified, varies_by_point false, and no point overrides.
The lake treatment edges array is empty and the progeny section has rows_cached 0.
Because treatment/progeny are intentionally not derived, the page should not present an unqualified good-law/foundational treatment claim.
residual_risks: Full treatment review may later support the good-law/foundational statement, but it is not verified from the disclosed files.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Align all visible treatment language with the unverified lake status until a derived treatment basis exists.
